html:
G'oya

Bu masalaning asosiy tuzog'i JOIN'dagi ko'payish (fan-out). Bitta buyurtmaga bir nechta qaytarish to'g'ri kelishi mumkin. Jadvallarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ulasak, buyurtma qatori har bir qaytarish uchun takrorlanadi va uning qty si SUM(o.qty) da bir necha marta qo'shiladi. Yechim: "ko'p" tomonni avval buyurtma bo'yicha yig'ib, keyin ulash. Shunda har buyurtmaga ko'pi bilan bitta qator to'g'ri keladi.

Yechim

WITH ret AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(qty) AS qty
  FROM returns
  GROUP BY order_id
),
per_seller AS (
  SELECT p.seller_id,
         SUM(o.qty) AS sold,
         COALESCE(SUM(r.qty), 0) AS returned
  FROM orders o
  JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id
  LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.order_id = o.id
  GROUP BY p.seller_id
)
SELECT s.id AS seller_id, s.name, ps.sold, ps.returned,
       ROUND(100.0 * ps.returned / ps.sold, 1) AS return_pct
FROM per_seller ps
JOIN sellers s ON s.id = ps.seller_id
ORDER BY return_pct DESC, s.id

per_seller buyurtmalardan boshlanadi, shuning uchun buyurtmasiz sotuvchi u yerga umuman tushmaydi va nolga bo'lish bo'lmaydi. Qaytarishsiz buyurtmalarda r.qty NULL, SUM ularni o'tkazib yuboradi. Sotuvchida birorta ham qaytarish bo'lmasa, SUM NULL beradi va COALESCE uni 0 ga aylantiradi.

Tuzoqlar

Namunadagi Aziz: 10 + 5 = 15 dona sotgan, 1-buyurtmadan ikki marta, jami 3 dona qaytgan. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri ulashda 1-buyurtma ikki qatorga aylanadi va sotuv 25 bo'lib chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT s.id AS seller_id, s.name,
       SUM(o.qty) AS sold,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.qty), 0) AS returned,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.qty), 0) / SUM(o.qty), 1) AS return_pct
FROM sellers s
JOIN products p ON p.seller_id = s.id
JOIN orders o ON o.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
ORDER BY return_pct DESC, s.id

SUM(DISTINCT o.qty) bilan tuzatishga urinish boshqa xato beradi: sotuvchining ikki buyurtmasida 5 tadan bo'lsa, ulardan biri yo'qoladi.

Saralashdagi ikkinchi kalitni unutmang. Ulushlar ko'pincha teng chiqadi, ayniqsa 0 lar.

Boshqa yo'l

Sotilganlar va qaytganlarni ikki alohida so'rovda sotuvchi bo'yicha yig'ib, keyin sotuvchi bo'yicha ulash ham mumkin. Bunda ham har tomon avval yig'iladi, shuning uchun ko'payish bo'lmaydi:

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.seller_id, SUM(o.qty) AS sold
  FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id
  GROUP BY p.seller_id
),
ret AS (
  SELECT p.seller_id, SUM(r.qty) AS returned
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id
  GROUP BY p.seller_id
)
SELECT s.id AS seller_id, s.name, so.sold,
       COALESCE(re.returned, 0) AS returned,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(re.returned, 0) / so.sold, 1) AS return_pct
FROM sellers s
JOIN sold so ON so.seller_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN ret re ON re.seller_id = s.id
ORDER BY return_pct DESC, s.id
